CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 4, 2021

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  Tang

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner; and Alondra Espinoza, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-22 AND REVISION TO
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-16-15
  • 1508 South Marengo Avenue
  • Applicant: TAG-2 Medical Investment Group LLC
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-21-22 and Revision to Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 for the
  construction of a new 2-story, 11,286 square foot, 34-bed skilled
  nursing facility addition to an existing skilled nursing facility located on
  a site of approximately 69,261 square feet (1.59 acres) located in the
  R-3 (High Density Residential) zone. An addendum to the previously
  adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for this project has been
  prepared.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-15, approving the
  CEQA Addendum, Planned Development Permit PD-21-22, and
  Revision to Conditional Use Permit CU-16-15 subject to the
  Conditions of Approval.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the staff presentation.
  • Steven St. Clair and Bruce Macpherson, Applicants, were available
  for questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  MOTION:
  1
  10/4/2021
   •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Tang

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-30, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-21-12 & VARIANCE V-21-11
  • 2505 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Omar Hernandez and Encarnacion Gutierrez
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit, and Variance to establish an approximately
  753 square foot exterior covered patio for outdoor dining for an
  existing restaurant on a site of approximately 21,531 square feet
  located at 2505 West Valley Boulevard in the VSP (Valley Boulevard
  Corridor Specific Plan) zone in the City of Alhambra. A Variance is
  requested to reduce the number of required on-site parking spaces.
  (This item is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Deny Planned Development Permit PD-21-
  30, Conditional Use Permit CUP-21-12 & Variance V-21-11.
  • Associate Planner Scott Quyle provided the staff presentation.
  • Omar Hernandez, Encarnacion Gutierrez, and Gilbert Gutierrez,
  Applicants, were available for questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Joanne Trang

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue Item 2 to the November 15, 2021, meeting of the
  Planning Commission.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Tang

G.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT
  2
  10/4/2021
   •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso reported the City Council took the Planning
  Commission’s recommendation to direct staff to submit the Housing Element to HCD
  to begin their 60-day review. It’s anticipated to submit the document for final approval
  to  Planning  Commission  and  City  Council  in  January.
  She also reported the City’s launch of the first phase of the Historic Preservation
  Program. The website is now live. A virtual community meeting will be held on October
  13th.

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Melissa Michelson commented on the Villages project. She is grateful for the
  Planning Commission and City Council’s vote to reject the project.

J.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Sahu inquired about the timing of the upcoming Zoning update.
  •  Commissioner Wang inquired about the Housing Element update, the next steps, and
  the general timeline.

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:54 P.M. to Monday,
  October 18, 2021, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President

ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant
